title: OpenDevBoard Overview

panels.title: API availability
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status for the internal API metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Last successful sync
panels.description: Elapsed time since the most recent successful sync. Amber begins at one hour; coral begins at 24 hours.

panels.title: API memory
panels.description: API process memory. Amber marks 1 GiB; coral marks the existing 1.5 GiB alert threshold.

panels.title: HTTP error rate
panels.description: 429, 503, client/server and network errors divided by attempts in a rolling five-minute window.

panels.title: Since last successful sync
panels.description: Elapsed time since the most recent successful sync. Amber begins at one hour; coral begins at 24 hours.

panels.title: Sync runs by mode
panels.description: Full and incremental sync runs over the selected time range.

panels.title: Sync outcomes
panels.description: Share of successful, partial and failed runs in the recent evaluation window.

panels.title: Sync duration · P50 / P95
panels.description: Median and 95th percentile full sync duration.

panels.title: Scheduler backoff
panels.description: Current scheduler retry delay. A longer delay indicates repeated unsuccessful or partial runs.

panels.title: Context closure
panels.description: Shows whether a partial sync left context closure work that requires a later full sync.

panels.title: API scrape health
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status for the internal API metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Current API memory
panels.description: API process memory. Amber marks 1 GiB; coral marks the existing 1.5 GiB alert threshold.

panels.title: Process peak memory
panels.description: API process memory. Amber marks 1 GiB; coral marks the existing 1.5 GiB alert threshold.

panels.title: Latest sync peak memory
panels.description: API process memory. Amber marks 1 GiB; coral marks the existing 1.5 GiB alert threshold.

panels.title: API CPU utilization
panels.description: Process CPU usage normalized to one CPU core.

panels.title: Sync CPU duration · P95
panels.description: 95th percentile CPU time consumed by a sync run.

panels.title: Sync phase duration · P95
panels.description: 95th percentile wall time by sync phase.

panels.title: Work Item throughput
panels.description: Work Items fetched or upserted per second.

panels.title: Context Item throughput
panels.description: Context Items processed per second.

panels.title: HTTP attempts by method
panels.description: Five-minute smoothed Azure DevOps request rate, grouped by HTTP method.

panels.title: Retry attempts
panels.description: Five-minute smoothed retry rate. A sustained rise can indicate rate limiting or transient upstream failures.

panels.title: Retries per attempt
panels.description: Retry attempts divided by all HTTP attempts in a rolling five-minute window. Values can exceed 100% during retry bursts.

panels.title: Throttling · 429 / 503
panels.description: Five-minute smoothed Azure DevOps rate limiting and service unavailable response rates.

panels.title: HTTP error rate
panels.description: HTTP and network errors divided by all attempts in a rolling five-minute window.

panels.title: WIQL request rate
panels.description: Five-minute smoothed Work Item Query Language request rate.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Azure DevOps HTTP attempts per second, smoothed over five minutes.

panels.title: Retry / attempt ratio
panels.description: Retry attempts divided by all HTTP attempts in a rolling five-minute window.

panels.title: HTTP error / attempt ratio
panels.description: 429, 503, client/server and network errors divided by attempts in a rolling five-minute window.

description: One-page operational view: general health followed by sync, performance, and Azure DevOps HTTP details.
